statement: Text resolution is exercised against the declared pack: the readouts that were previously concatenated in the runtime, glyph substitution inside messages, loud failure for undeclared names, and the swap that proves wording is data.

results.case: coverage reads exactly as the frozen reference did
zoom formats as a whole percentage
a view option carries the label and its counts

a route choice uses the declared arrow
the source pointer keeps its digest and pointer
a parallel trace wave uses the declared range dash
no message in the pack spells a glyph literally
play labels cover every lifecycle state
view kind names cover every supported kind
an undeclared format renders visibly wrong, not empty
an undeclared message renders visibly wrong, not empty
a missing placeholder value renders visibly wrong, not a stray brace
changing one glyph reaches every string that uses it
changing a glyph does not disturb formats that never used it
rewording a format changes only that readout
